p. p. [क्षुद्-क्त] 
__1 Pounded, crushed to pieces, bruised. 
__2 Powdered, pulverized, ground.

__5 Violated (a vow); [[Rām. 1.]] 
__6 Exercised, practised, skilful. 
__7 One versed in the sacred science but unable to teach it.

€7U. (क्षुणत्ति, क्षुन्ते, क्षुण्ण) 
__1 To tread or trample upon, strike against, crush (under the foot), bruise, pound down; क्षुणद्मि सर्पान् पाताले [[Bk. 6. 36]]; ते तं व्याशिषताक्षौत्सुः पादैर्दन्तैस्तथाच्छिदन् 15. 43; 17. 66. 
__2 To move, be agitated (Ā.); क्षोदन्तं आपो रिणते वनानि [[Rv. 5. 58. 6.]] -With प्र to crush, bruise, pound; मित्रघ्नस्य प्रचुक्षोद गदयाङ्गं बिभीषणः [[Bk. 14. 33.]]
f. Grinding, crushing.
